q: What is the Federal Register citation for the final rule replacing duration of status with fixed admission periods, and what are its publication and effective dates?
truth: FR doc 2026-14439, published July 17, 2026, effective September 15, 2026. The Aug 28, 2025 document (90 FR 42070) is the NPRM, not the final rule.

q: Under the new fixed admission period rule, what is the maximum initial admission period for an F-1 student, and what grace periods apply?
truth: Up to 4 years, 30-day pre-program entry window, 30-day grace period after completion under the new rule. Citation must be the FINAL rule (2026-14439), not the NPRM.

q: For an F-1 student admitted for duration of status before the new rule takes effect, what is the latest date they can remain without filing for an extension of stay?
truth: November 14, 2030 (transition math per DHS FAQ); 8 CFR 214.1(m)(1).

q: What is the maximum admission period for an F-1 student in an English language training program under the new rule?
truth: 24 months aggregate plus the 30-day grace period.

q: How long may an F-1 student attend a U.S. public high school?
If an F-1 student admitted under duration of status travels abroad and re-enters after September 15, 2026, how are they admitted?
truth: Admitted for a fixed period on return — to the I-20 program end date, max 4 years.

q: Under the new rule's transition provisions, what is the deadline connected to OPT applications and the rule's publication date?
When can an F-1 student file for post-completion OPT, and what is the SEVIS recommendation rule?
truth: Up to 90 days before the program end date; since September 15, 2026 the window closes 30 days after the program end date (was 60 before the DS final rule); must also file within 30 days of the DSO's SEVIS recommendation; amended 8 CFR 214.2(f)(11)(i)(B)(2), 91 FR 44976.

q: What grace period does an F-1 student have after completing their program, and does the new rule change it?
truth: 60 days currently; 30 days under the new rule once effective. Citation must be the final rule, not '90 FR 42089 / Aug 28 2025' (NPRM).

q: What is a full course of study for an F-1 undergraduate at a college or university?
How much is the I-901 SEVIS fee for an F-1 student?
What happens to an F-1 student's OPT if they transfer to another school?
truth: OPT authorization auto-terminates at the transfer release date; 5-month rule considerations for the new program.

q: Can I authorize CPT for a student's internship if the internship is related to their major but not required for their degree? Anything new I should know?
truth: Regulation: 8 CFR 214.2(f)(10)(i) — integral part of an established curriculum, directly related to major. New: SEVP Broadcast Message 2608-01 (Aug 12, 2026) announces increased scrutiny, documentation requests, and personal DSO liability framing; its 'required for all students / degree impossible without it' language is the broadcast's requested standard, stricter than the regulation, and the BCM is guidance, not a rule.

q: A student asks whether enrolling in SNAP or Medicaid could affect their immigration status. What should I tell them after this fall?
truth: 2026 final rule (91 FR 45324, pub 7/20/26, eff 9/18/26) rescinds the 2022 rule; on/after 9/18/26 any means-tested public benefit — including applying — may be considered; before that date the 2022 standard (cash assistance/long-term institutionalization) applies. F/J are covered; exposure points are visa issuance, admission at port of entry, later adjustment.
